_comment: gygax v2 (2026-06-22) — re-designed with the ENGINE-LEGAL palette + a critical ability correction: Crustle [345] WALLS ex attackers (prevents damage from opp ex Pokemon's attacks) and is vulnerable to NON-ex / status / non-attack damage. The {ex}-patch was dropped (solves a matchup we already win 0.73-0.81). These 3 target the REAL hole, all cards verified in legal-cards.json. NOTE: the coliseum field (Crustle-mirror + gumi-v8 + greedy) does NOT contain the non-ex/status counters, so the pre-screen is a DO-NO-HARM check; the adaptation's real value is ladder-only (C4 info-gain).

variants.name: crustle-cape
variants.rationale: OUT-BULK the non-ex grind (V1, highest prior): +3 Hero's Cape -> 250-HP Crustle out-bulks single-prize/non-ex attackers + blunts {R}-weakness x2. Cut from over-floored Basic {G} only (19->16; energy 28). Falsifiable: if meta runs tool-hate (Tool Scrapper/Jamming Tower), stacking Cape backfires -> flat/negative (itself a clean read).

variants.name: crustle-pivotcleanse
variants.rationale: STATUS vector (wall doesn't stop poison/burn — placed between turns, not 'by an attack'): Switch (retreat clears conditions off the active) + Lumiose Galette (heal 20 + REMOVE a Special Condition). Isolates status-attrition. Falsifiable: if no status in meta, low-value -> flat.

variants.name: crustle-recur
variants.rationale: RENEWABLE WALL vs chip-grind: Night Stretcher (retrieve a KO'd Crustle/Dwebble or Basic Energy from discard -> rebuild the wall) + Switch (rotate a battered Crustle to bench for the Cook/Jumbo heal engine; both heals already at 4-cap so recursion is the only sustain lever). Isolates chip-grind. Falsifiable: if meta one-shots Crustle (burst) or hard-walls us, recursion is irrelevant -> flat.
